title: A change since a revision names the docs and the kb CODE facts it makes stale, in any repository with a docs map
goal: kbingest.py impact REPO --since REV prints one 'doc PATH' line for each doc that the repository's docs map (the csv its backlog.json docs_map names) ties to a file changed since REV; it prints one 'fact KBPATH:LINE' line for each kb CODE fact that kbingest.py drift REPO --rev HEAD reports, with no model; it runs on a project that installs the plugin against that project's own docs map; on this repository its doc lines are the docs selfdoc.py map names for the files changed since REV.

run: import subprocess as s,sys;f=s.run(['git','diff','--name-only','HEAD~5','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.split();m=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/selfdoc.py','map']+f,capture_output=True,text=True);want={l.split(': ')[0] for l in m.stdout.splitlines() if ': ' in l};p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbingest.py','impact','.','--since','HEAD~5'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900);got={l.split()[1] for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('doc ')};print(sorted(want),sorted(got),p.stderr[-300:]);sys.exit(0 if p.returncode in (0,1) and got==want else 1)

import subprocess as s,sys;d=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbingest.py','drift','.','--rev','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900);want={l.split(chr(9))[2] for l in d.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('finding')};p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbingest.py','impact','.','--since','HEAD~5'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900);got={l.split()[1] for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('fact ')};print(sorted(want),sorted(got),p.stderr[-300:]);sys.exit(0 if p.returncode in (0,1) and got==want else 1)

import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();g=lambda *a:s.run(['git','-C',d]+list(a),capture_output=True,check=True);g('init','-q');os.makedirs(os.path.join(d,'docs'));os.makedirs(os.path.join(d,'src'));open(os.path.join(d,'backlog.json'),'w').write(json.dumps({'docs_map':'docs/map.csv'}));open(os.path.join(d,'docs','map.csv'),'w').write('doc,pattern'+chr(10)+'docs/a.md,src/*.py'+chr(10));open(os.path.join(d,'docs','a.md'),'w').write('# A'+chr(10));open(os.path.join(d,'src','x.py'),'w').write('X = 1'+chr(10));c=lambda m:g('-c','user.name=chk','-c','user.email=chk@example.com','commit','-qam',m);g('add','.');c('one');open(os.path.join(d,'src','x.py'),'w').write('X = 2'+chr(10));c('two');p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbingest.py','impact',d,'--since','HEAD~1'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300);print(p.stdout,p.stderr[-300:]);sys.exit(0 if 'doc docs/a.md' in p.stdout else 1)
